visualIdentity: The same small five-pointed star in every picture, recognisable when tiny, in the hands, or rising.
shape: five even points, a simple star
relativeScale: small enough to rest in two open palms; the same shape when it is a speck or when it rises
materials: soft light, not metal, not paper, not a sticker
distinctiveFeatures: points fold inward when it hides
mutableState: points open or folded, brightness, and position. The shape and glow stay the same.
